business_summary: Hokuriku Electric Power Company supplies electricity through power generation, transmission, and distribution systems in Japan. The company generates electricity through hydroelectric, thermal, and nuclear sources. It is also involved in the sale of LNG; construction of thermal and nuclear power plant equipment; architecture, civil engineering, and paving works; design and construction business; maintenance of hydroelectric power generation substation; distribution facilities; electricity, air conditioning, water supply and drainage, communication equipment construction, and plumbing business; and manufacturing and sale of concrete poles and piles. The company also engages in providing data transmission line and office support work services; development and sale of software, logistics management system, and stem contract; real estate rental and management, temporary staffing, and leasing business; energy solutions, home sales, and gas retail business; execution of environmental greening projects; civil engineering and construction works; administrative services related to administrative indirect operations. In addition, it is involved in investment management business; manufacturing, repairing and testing electricity meters; manufacturing and sales of transformers and switchboards; cable television broadcasting service and internet service; construction and operation of black pellet manufacturing plants. The company was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Toyama, Japan.
business_summary_ko: 호쿠리쿠전력(Hokuriku Electric Power Company)은 일본의 발전, 송배전 시스템을 통해 전기를 공급합니다. 이 회사는 수력, 열, 원자력을 통해 전기를 생산합니다. LNG 판매에도 참여하고 있습니다. 화력 및 원자력 발전소 장비 건설; 건축, 토목공학, 포장 공사; 설계 및 건설업; 수력 발전 변전소의 유지 관리; 유통시설; 전기, 공조, 상하수도, 통신설비공사, 배관사업; 콘크리트 기둥 및 말뚝 제조 및 판매업을 하고 있습니다. 회사는 또한 데이터 전송 회선 및 사무 지원 업무 서비스를 제공합니다. 소프트웨어, 물류 관리 시스템, 줄기 계약 개발 및 판매; 부동산 임대 및 관리, 임시 직원 채용, 임대 사업; 에너지 솔루션, 주택 판매, 가스 소매 사업; 환경녹화사업 실시; 토목공학 및 건축 공사; 행정 간접 운영과 관련된 행정 서비스. 또한 투자 관리 사업에도 참여하고 있습니다. 제조업
